connector.name: Cycles - Budget Authority for AI Agents
connector.registryDescription: Runtime budget authority for AI agents - reserve, enforce, reconcile spend across providers
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the runcycles account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CYCLES_API_KEY
env.description: Cycles API key for authentication. Set CYCLES_MOCK=true for local development without a key.

env.name: CYCLES_BASE_URL
env.description: URL of the Cycles server (e.g. https://api.runcycles.io). Required unless CYCLES_MOCK=true.

env.name: CYCLES_MOCK
env.description: Enable mock mode for local development — no API key or live server required.
